claims.statement: Billy Madden said Tom Allen was a first-class man and hard hitter but that John L. Sullivan could have beaten him in his prime.
claims.excerpt:
Tom Allen isa first-class man
and a hard hitter, but the Boston Boy could
whip him in his palmy or.
